records.title: Sublingual apomorphine for Parkinsonian tremor: a post-hoc analysis of pivotal trial data
records.design: Post-hoc-Analyse einer pivotalen 12-Wochen-RCT plus offene 12-Monats-Studie; tremor-dominante Subgruppe 17 SL-APO / 14 Placebo; Post-Werte n=10/10
records.eligibility_reason: Zwei randomisierte Arme und ein kontinuierliches Outcome mit n/Mean/SD zu Woche 12; weitere Outcomes sind nur als Veränderung, Prozentwerte oder qualitativ berichtet.

outcomes.outcome: Tremor index at 30 min post-dose, Week 12
outcomes.note: Post-hoc; nur n=10/10 mit Post-Werten; 17/14 randomisiert.
outcomes.source_quote: Results | Mean ± SD tremor index scores decreased from 11.0 ± 4.8 pre-dose to 5.7 ± 3.3 at 30 min post-intake with SL-APO (n = 10), versus 12.4 ± 4.8 to 11.3 ± 5.7 with placebo (n = 10).

outcomes.outcome: Change in tremor index at 30 min, Week 12
outcomes.note: Within-group change: -5.3 [-7.3; -3.3] mit SL-APO und -1.1 [-2.5; 0.3] mit Placebo; Placebo-SD der Veränderung nicht berichtet.
outcomes.source_quote: Results | The within-group change was − 5.3 [− 7.3; −3.3] with SL‑APO and − 1.1 [− 2.5; 0.3] with placebo, yielding a between-group treatment effect of − 4.4 [− 6.5; −2.3] (p < 0.001; Fig. 1a).

outcomes.note: Nur 80% vs. 30% bei n=10/10; keine Ereigniszahlen berichtet, keine Rekonstruktion.
outcomes.source_quote: Results | Based on a calculated MIC of 2.3, responder rates were 80% with SL‑APO and 30% with placebo, supported by cumulative distribution function plots showing a consistent shift toward greater improvement with SL‑APO (Fig. 1c).

outcomes.note: Nur qualitative Aussage zu beiden Tremor-Subtypen; keine armweisen Werte.
outcomes.source_quote: Results | Improvements reflected reductions in both rest and postural tremor.

records.eligibility_reason: Zwei randomisierte Arme sind berichtet, aber die klinischen Outcomes liegen nur als adjustierte OR/HR und p-Werte vor; keine armweisen Ereigniszahlen oder Time-to-Event-Rohdaten.

records.title: Non‐contrast CT Markers of Hematoma Expansion and Andexanet Response in Factor Xa Inhibitor‐Associated Intracerebral Hemorrhage: An Analysis from ANNEXa‐I Trial
records.design: Post-hoc-Sekundäranalyse der ANNEXa-I-RCT; 434 von 530 ITT mit Bildgebung; Andexanet vs. Usual Care
records.eligibility_reason: Randomisierte Arme sind im Design berichtet, aber die HE-Outcomes liegen nur als Gesamtfrequenz, Subgruppeninteraktionen oder adjustierte Assoziationen vor; keine armweisen Ereignisse/Total.

outcomes.note: Gesamtpopulation 138/434 (31.8%); keine armweisen Ereigniszahlen im Text.
outcomes.source_quote: Patients' Characteristics | Among 530 patients in the intention‐to‐treat population, 434 (197 female, mean age 79.3 ± 8.1 years) had qualifying ICH, baseline NCCT, and follow‐up imaging available for assessment of HE and were included in this study (Figure S2). HE was observed in 138 patients (31.8%).

outcomes.note: Nur definiertes Outcome; keine armweisen Ereigniszahlen im Text.
outcomes.source_quote: Outcomes | The secondary outcome was severe HE, defined as ≥12.5 ml or ≥ 66% increase.

outcomes.note: Nur absolute Reduktion 19.5% vs. 8.0% berichtet; keine Ereigniszahlen.
outcomes.source_quote: Treatment Interaction of Andexanet | The absolute reduction in HE with andexanet appeared greater in patients with hypodensity (19.5% vs. 8.0%) than those without.

outcomes.note: Nur Interaktions-OR 0.03 (0.00-0.29) vs. 0.60 (0.38-0.96), p=0.01; keine Ereigniszahlen.
outcomes.source_quote: Treatment Interaction of Andexanet | A treatment interaction was observed for the blend sign (OR 0.03, 95% CI 0.00–0.29 for those with blend sign; and OR 0.60, 95% CI 0.38–0.96 for those without, p for interaction = 0.01).

records.short_title: Dupilumab and COPD exacerbation resource use
records.title: Dupilumab in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: a pooled analysis of emergency department visits, hospital admissions, and systemic corticosteroid use
records.design: Post-hoc-gepoolte Analyse von BOREAS und NOTUS; Dupilumab 938 / Placebo 936; 52 Wochen
records.eligibility_reason: Zwei RCTs mit zwei Armen und Ereigniszahlen, aber die Analyse poolt BOREAS und NOTUS; die vier Outcomes überlappen sich und sind nicht als vier unabhängige Outcomes zu zählen.

outcomes.outcome: Patients with >=1 ED visit/hospital admission, 52 weeks
outcomes.note: Gepoolte ITT-Population; Ereignisse/Total aus Text.
outcomes.source_quote: Emergency department visits/hospitalizations | In the pooled ITT population, 5.3% (50 of 938) of patients receiving dupilumab and 8.5% (80 of 936) of patients receiving placebo had 65 and 96 ED visits/hospital admissions, respectively, during the 52-week treatment period.

outcomes.note: Subgruppe mit Überlappung zu Slot 1; exakte Patientenzahlen aus Baseline-Charakteristik.
outcomes.source_quote: Baseline demographics and disease characteristics | Baseline demographics and disease characteristics for the pooled ITT population (dupilumab: N = 938; placebo: N = 936), patients without an exacerbation event during the study (dupilumab: n = 600; placebo: n = 542), and patients with ≥ 1 severe exacerbation (dupilumab: n = 41; placebo: n = 60) or moderate exacerbation(s) only (dupilumab: n = 297; placebo: n = 334) during the study were similar across treatment arms and subgroups (Table 1 and Table S1).

outcomes.outcome: Patients with systemic corticosteroid use, 52 weeks
outcomes.note: Überlappt mit Exazerbations-Outcomes; Ereignisse/Total aus Text.
outcomes.source_quote: Systemic corticosteroid use | Overall, 33.6% (315 of 938) of patients receiving dupilumab and 39.1% (366 of 936) receiving placebo reported systemic corticosteroid use during the treatment period.

outcomes.note: Subgruppe der Hospitalisierten; überlappt mit Slot 1 und Slot 2.
outcomes.source_quote: Severe exacerbations | Of patients receiving dupilumab, 0.3% (3 of 938) had 3 COPD-related admissions to an intensive care unit; of patients receiving placebo, 0.7% (7 of 936) reported 7 admissions to an intensive care unit.
